patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: Okay, this is so embarrassing, but my left one down there really hurts. It woke me straight out of sleep, and I feel like I might throw up. Can I please just get some ibuprofen and go home?
presentation.triageNote: 16-year-old boy with sudden severe left testicular pain that woke him from sleep, now accompanied by nausea. He is pale, guarded, and rates the pain 8 of 10.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because sudden severe testicular pain with nausea is a time-sensitive, high-risk presentation requiring rapid evaluation for threatened testicular viability.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This adolescent has sudden severe unilateral testicular pain with nausea and needs rapid assessment for a time-sensitive surgical cause.
clinical.acuityReason: Abrupt pain awakening a teenager from sleep, associated nausea, pallor, and guarded behavior create a high-risk pattern even though the vital signs are stable.
expectedResources: Doppler ultrasound if it will not delay definitive care
redFlags: Sudden unilateral testicular pain with nausea
teachingPoints: A patient may minimize an embarrassing complaint despite a time-sensitive emergency.
Evaluation and specialty involvement should not be delayed when the presentation strongly suggests threatened testicular viability.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Urgent examination and urologic assessment would determine whether immediate operative exploration is needed; rapid treatment offers the best chance of preserving the testicle.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting hunched and slightly turned away, hands protective in his lap
aiImageGeneration.expression: pale and queasy, trying to downplay it and look fine
signs: guarded, embarrassed posture, wincing when he shifts
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a Hispanic 16-year-old boy in gaming-logo pajama pants, on the same blue clinic chair. Pose: sitting hunched and slightly turned away, hands protective in his lap. Expression: pale and queasy, trying to downplay it and look fine — NOT a big grimace. Clearly visible: pale faintly-sweaty face, guarded embarrassed posture. Overall a teen downplaying something that is actually serious. No text, no logos.
